notes: Cross-verified against three official Sharp/NEC sources: the live manufacturer datasheet at sharpnecdisplays.eu/datasheet/v754q (fetched 2026-07-24), the identical Sharp NEC Display Solutions Europe GmbH PDF datasheet (order code 60004317), and the official English V654Q/V754Q/V864Q/V984Q User's Manual (terminal panel diagram + "Specifications - V754Q" table), all of which agree on port counts, dimensions, weight (52.6-53kg) and power draw. This is the standard (non-touch) MultiSync V754Q — touch variants (V754Q IGB, V754Q-TM3) and tuner/media-player SKUs (V754Q-AVT3, V754Q-MPI, V754Q-PC4) carry different port sets and are out of scope here. A microSD card slot (MediaPlayer storage) exists on the terminal panel but is omitted as it has no matching connector id in the schema (not a cable/AV signal or power connector). HDMI grade of 2.0 is inferred from the manual's confirmed 4096x2160@60Hz MODE2 support with HDCP 2.2 (requires 18Gbps bandwidth); DisplayPort grade of 1.2 and LAN grade of 100M are explicitly stated in the source. The AC IN connector form factor (IEC C13/C14 vs. other detachable-cord variants) is inferred, not explicitly spelled out in either source.

ports.name: DisplayPort 2
ports.note: MST not available on this input per manual

ports.name: DisplayPort Out
ports.note: Loop-through daisy-chain output sourced from DisplayPort 1 (also carries OPS slot-in PC video)

ports.name: Audio In
ports.note: Stereo mini jack, 0.5 Vrms analogue audio input

ports.name: Audio Out
ports.note: Stereo mini jack line-level output to external amp/receiver; manual notes this is not a headphone jack

ports.name: Remote In
ports.note: 3.5mm jack for optional external IR sensor extension

ports.name: LAN1
ports.note: 10BASE-T/100BASE-TX; manual states to give priority of use to LAN1

ports.name: USB1
ports.note: Downstream port for connecting USB devices (flash drive, keyboard, etc.)

ports.name: USB2
ports.note: Upstream port; a host computer connected here can control devices plugged into USB1

ports.name: USB CM1 (2A)
ports.note: Compute Module bay power-supply port, 5V/2A max

ports.name: USB CM2
ports.note: Compute Module bay service port for maintenance; manual states not to connect general devices

ports.name: USB MP
ports.note: Downstream port dedicated to MediaPlayer content storage / firmware update

ports.name: External Speaker Terminal
ports.note: Actual connector is a bare-wire screw/spring-clip terminal block (+/- polarity marked), rated for 15W+15W into 8 ohms; 'euroblock' used as closest available connector id, not a literal pluggable Euroblock

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: AC IN connector for detachable IEC-style power cord, rated 100-240V AC 50/60Hz, 4.0-1.7A (155W shipping / 210W max); source describes a standard detachable cord (H05VV-F 3G 0.75mm2 in Europe) but does not explicitly state the C13/C14 inlet form factor
